native_output_handoff.observed_order: KRYN execute.after receives the complete child result before OpenCode truncates it. OpenCode later emits session.tool.success with metadata.outputPath and saves the full text.
native_output_handoff.installed_351_trial: evals/runs/green-20260928-native-handoff351/evidence/audit-handoff2: native Audit delegated a fresh Reviewer; the exact saved tool-output path was recorded in KRYN's private tracker, yet the parent read and glob both failed with Permission denied: external_directory. This disposable trial sets an explicit external-directory deny, which the hook-level allow did not override; ordinary daily Ask behavior was not qualified.
native_output_handoff.decision: Removed the ineffective saved-path grant and its configuration, tracker field and tests. The parent honestly reported the denied read; later config-only evidence is recorded separately below.

native_output_config_fix.change: Native Audit uses the same OpenCode read and external-directory allowance for managed tool-output files as the existing Browse role, with other external directories denied. No new agent framework or custom file reader was added.
native_output_config_fix.diagnostic: A daily-like disposable config, with the evaluator-only blanket external-directory deny omitted, completed a native child and read its saved truncated output. The evaluator's ordinary deny intentionally prevents this workflow and cannot qualify daily permissions.
native_output_config_fix.installed_trial: evals/runs/green-20260928-audit-installedff/evidence/child-read: on installed ff69aa9, a fresh Reviewer completed, its result was forced to truncate at 256 bytes, and Audit read the exact saved output file. Driver completed in 47.248 seconds with no resource intervention.
native_output_config_fix.negative_control: evals/runs/green-20260928-audit-installedff/evidence/outside-deny: Audit read of a disposable file outside the project and managed tool-output directory was denied as external_directory; driver completed in 16.625 seconds.
native_output_config_fix.restart_trial: evals/runs/green-20260928-audit-installedff/evidence/restart-read: the saved native Audit session resumed under a new OpenCode server process and read its prior child report in 36.232 seconds. It searched the managed output directory before choosing the exact file, so this does not prove direct checkpoint recall or bounded discovery.
native_output_config_fix.normal_threshold_trial: evals/runs/green-20260928-audit-normalff/evidence/audit-child: an operator-copied failed Task12 source was audited under the installed 4096-byte threshold; a fresh Reviewer report truncated, Audit read the saved file and completed in 148.618 seconds. This is read-only mechanism evidence, not a model-produced coding/UI pass. The Reviewer falsely stated that textContent parses HTML and recommended innerHTML; Audit repeated the false recommendation.
native_output_config_fix.resources: All three guarded handoff trials sampled normal pressure and unchanged 3,019,898-byte swap; the Mac was on battery. No resource intervention occurred.
native_output_config_fix.limits: Repeated compaction of the child handoff was not exercised. Reviewer's factual accuracy failed. The allowance covers the managed tool-output directory, which the pre-existing Browse role could already read; a resumed model searched that directory instead of retrieving the exact prior path from a checkpoint.
